manifest.name: Today Sidebar
manifest.description: A lightweight task system for Obsidian with WYSIWYG task documents, lists, boards, timeline, calendar and statistics.
manifest.author: OpenAI

changes: Adapted CommonJS Obsidian imports and default export to local ES modules.
Exported normalizeData for the native host.
Disabled automatic demonstration-data seeding; real task behavior is retained.
Replaced unsupported Electron window.prompt calls with awaited in-app text dialogs.
Unified folder/list/group/board task creation through the existing full inline composer, preserving lane defaults and continuous capture.

Added readable capture properties and inline descriptions, a completion-time history with list/date filters, and save-before-switch docked detail navigation based on direct TickTick desktop workflow review.
